coverage_summary.eia: 2018-01 through 2026-08 (51 jurisdictions: 50 states + DC), monthly residential utility sales
coverage_summary.resstock: AMY 2018, 10 profiles (CO, NY), 15-minute intervals (35,040 per bldg); individual patterns and stratum-level aggregate patterns
coverage_summary.climate: 2018-01-01 to 2018-01-07, 2 point locations in Colorado (Denver, Grand Junction), ERA5-Land hourly
coverage_summary.demography: 2020 through 2025 (51 jurisdictions: 50 states + DC), annual residential sales, population estimates (Vintage 2025) and density

methodology_separation.resstock_modelled: 10 physical building energy simulation models (AMY 2018). Exploratory sample across 2 states (CO, NY); does not represent national totals. Timestamps converted explicitly from fixed EST to UTC and local IANA time zones by county (NOAA/NWS c_16ap26).

resstock_pattern_aggregate.grain: (state_code, housing_type, time_zone, period_local, day_type, hour_local, utc_offset_minutes)
resstock_pattern_aggregate.temporal_handling: Explicit conversion: fixed EST (-15m to interval start) -> UTC (+5h) -> local IANA zones resolved by county FIPS (NOAA/NWS c_16ap26), preserving utc_offset_minutes, excluding incomplete hours (<4 intervals), and deriving is_partial_period by civil month coverage.
resstock_pattern_aggregate.sample_representativeness: Modeled physical simulation profiles; does NOT represent population, census totals, or utility billing totals.
resstock_pattern_aggregate.scalability_purpose: Keeps browser payload bounded to stratum dimensions as sample size scales, while preserving individual inspection via lazy-load in gold_resstock_pattern.

methodology_separation.eia_sales: Aggregated official utility sales from Form EIA-861M for 51 jurisdictions. Completely distinct population and scope from ResStock.
methodology_separation.climate_reanalysis: ERA5-Land reanalysis for 2 point locations in CO; preserved decoupled without spatial or temporal join to consumption.

colorado_eia_comparison_metric.blocker: The raw ResStock Colorado aggregate dataset (timeseries_aggregates) is absent from origin/main. Per project governance and data integrity rules, no synthetic substitute is created, and the 87.16% figure is documented as an unverified external descriptive ratio, not an independently reproduced precision metric.

state_energy_demography.sources: Census PEP Vintage 2025, Census TIGERweb 2020 land area, EIA-861M final residential sales
state_energy_demography.methodology_separation: Aggregate macro-level data combining official Census Bureau population estimates and EIA utility sales. Fundamentally separate and decoupled from individual simulated building profiles (ResStock AMY 2018). The District of Columbia (DC) is an urban federal district (11,348 hab/mi²), distinct from the 50 states. Ratios and correlations between density, population, and sales per capita are strictly descriptive; no causal claim is made.

rules.condicion: filas == 350400 (N*35040) y edificios == 10
cada bldg_id tiene exactamente 35040 intervalos de 15 min (AMY 2018) y 10 edificios
0 nulos en campos bldg_id, timestamp_fin_local y electricidad_kwh
electricidad_kwh >= 0.0, no nula, no NaN y no infinita
par (bldg_id, timestamp_fin_local) sin duplicados
pasos consecutivos de exactamente 900s e inicio 2018-01-01 00:15 / fin 2019-01-01 00:00 por edificio
cada uno de los 10 perfiles tiene una fila válida en resstock_seleccion_propuesta.csv
filas == 5304 y estados == 51 (50 estados + DC)
0 nulos en todas las columnas (periodo, estado, sector, estado_dato, ventas_mwh)
periodo cumple regex ^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$
sector == 'RES' en todas las filas
estado_dato pertenece a {'Final', 'Preliminary'}
ventas_mwh >= 0.0, no nulo, no NaN y no infinito
tupla (periodo, estado, sector) sin duplicados
filas == 336 y puntos == 2 (168 h por punto, 7 días)
0 nulos en todas las columnas de la muestra de clima
modelo == 'ERA5-Land'
-60.0 <= temperatura_c <= 60.0, no nula y finita
latitudes [-90, 90] y longitudes [-180, 180] presentes, no nulas y finitas
tupla (punto_id, timestamp_utc) sin duplicados
pasos consecutivos de exactamente 3600s e inicio 2018-01-01 00:00Z / fin 2018-01-07 23:00Z por punto
filas == 306 (51 jurisdicciones x 6 años 2020-2025)
tupla (state_fips, year) sin duplicados
51 jurisdicciones (50 estados + DC) presentes en cada año 2020-2025
population, land_area, sales_mwh, density y kwh_per_capita estrictamente positivos
eia_data_status == 'Final' y census_vintage == 2025 en todas las filas
DC identificado con FIPS 11, años 2020-2025 y densidad urbana atípica (>10,000 hab/mi²)

analytics.anomaly_method: per-state year-over-year log change with seasonal median/MAD bounds; k=3.5

anomaly_counts.advertencia: Candidatos estadisticos para revision; no se afirman anomalias reales.
